title: Facebook, Tech Giants Whipsaw the Market
text:

https://www.barrons.com/articles/facebook-tech-giants-whipsaw-the-market-1522247952 Facebook, Tech Giants Whipsaw the Market March 28, 2018 10:39 a.m. ET Text Size Large Photo: Getty Images 
Tech stocks have become such heavyweights that they can send the stock market lurching up and down, and that’s become a concern for many investors. 
As The Wall Street Journal notes , the NYSE FANG+ Index—which tracks 10 global tech heavyweights, including Facebook (FB) Apple (AAPL) and Alibaba (BABA) dove 5.6% on Tuesday. The Dow fell 1.4%, the S&P 1.7%, and the Nasdaq 2.9%. 
Tech stocks’ “rapid gains have come alongside heavy inflows into passive funds that track these indexes, leaving millions of investors susceptible to greater downside should tech stocks struggle more,” the Journal writes. 
Through March 12, Facebook, Amazon (AMZN), Apple, Microsoft (MSFT) and Alphabet (GOOGL) had accounted for 45% of the S&P 500’s year-to-date gain. But Facebook, embroiled in controversy, has fallen sharply of late and is now down 14%. Apple and Alphabet have also slipped into the red for the year amid fears of tightening regulation. 
For better or worse, we’re all on the tech train now. Let’s hope it doesn’t jump the tracks. 
–Steve Garmhausen
